name: Eduentry
description: Eduentry operates two free adaptive assessment platforms: an academic benchmarking assessment for children aged 6–17, and an internship readiness assessment for high school students aged 14–18.

services.name: Academic Assessment
services.description: Free adaptive academic benchmark for children aged 6–17. Measures English, Mathematics, Verbal Reasoning, and Non-Verbal Reasoning against UK, US, PISA, and IB standards. Produces standardised scores (mean 100, SD 15) and international percentile rankings using 2PL Item Response Theory.

services.name: Internship Readiness Assessment
services.description: Free 34-question adaptive assessment for high school students aged 14–18. Evaluates general aptitude, domain knowledge, workplace skills (situational judgement), and interest profile across four professional tracks: Technology, Business, Data Analytics, and Digital Marketing. Generates a personalised readiness report with AI-powered insights.

resources.name: Methodology
resources.description: Technical explanation of the 2PL IRT adaptive scoring model and international benchmarking approach.

resources.name: Blog
resources.description: Research and guides on international academic benchmarks, standardised testing, school admissions, internship readiness, and career development.

agents.instructions: Eduentry provides free educational assessments. Use /llms.txt for a comprehensive site index. Use /.well-known/mcp.json for MCP server configuration. Assessment results are personalised and session-based — no public API for individual scores.
